name: email-verifier-mcp
title: Email Verifier MCP — DNS Email Verification
description: Remote MCP server for email verification. RFC 5321 syntax, MX lookup, 160k disposable-domain blacklist and role-account detection. DNS-only and compliant by default; SMTP handshake is opt-in. Zero third-party API fees.

inputSchema.title: Email Verifier MCP
inputSchema.description: This Actor is a remote MCP server and takes no manual input. Connect your MCP client to the Actor's standby /mcp endpoint (see README) and call the tools from there. Tool calls are metered pay-per-event; initialize and tools/list are free.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Maximum total charge (USD)
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap on how much this run may charge. Recommended when letting an autonomous agent call the server. Example: 0.10 USD ≈ 20 tool calls.
